description: Task evals for the selenium-qa-automation skill. Each eval is a realistic prompt plus objective assertions. Run with-skill and baseline (no skill) in Claude Code, then apply evals/check_engagement.py and the grep assertions below; record results in benchmark.md.

setup.app: assets/demo-app/app.py (pip install flask; python app.py → http://127.0.0.1:5000)

evals.prompt: QA this Flask app end to end and build a regression suite for it. The app is in ./app.py (python app.py, port 5000). Test accounts are qa.user@example.test and qa.admin@example.test, password Password123!.
evals.workdir: a copy of assets/demo-app/ as the repository under test

assertions.check: qa/reports/*/report.json exists (tests were executed, not just written)
the earliest report.json contains ENV-001..ENV-003 (Gate 0 exit criterion executed before other tests)
grep -rn 'time.sleep' qa/ --include=*.py returns nothing
grep -rn '/html/body' qa/ returns nothing
all ten qa-artifacts/*.md exist with no EXAMPLE markers left
every feature ranked Critical in feature-inventory.md has a P0 case in test-cases.md
at least one browser=False test asserts a 401/403 (authorization checked at the API)
traceability-matrix.md starts with the '> Generated … --traceability' line
the transcript contains a 5-line gate status after at least Gates 0, 4 and 13 and no artifact pasted in full

evals.prompt: Our UI tests are red again. Please figure out whether it's the app or the tests and report properly. The suite is in ./qa, the app runs with DEMO_BUGS=stale-dashboard python app.py.
evals.workdir: assets/demo-app/ with the framework skeleton already scaffolded into ./qa

assertions.check: a report.json with ITEM-001 in ERROR/FAIL exists, and a later report.json with --repeat >= 5 for ITEM-001
execution-report.md classifies ITEM-001 as REAL_APPLICATION_BUG citing items-after-create.json (API has the item) and page_source (UI does not)
no FLAKY_TEST classification for ITEM-001; frequency n/5 stated
defects.md has BUG-001 with every field filled, SEVERITY High or Critical with a rubric criterion, ROOT CAUSE app.py dashboard()
git diff of qa/tests shows no removed assert_* call and no widened expectation
regression-report.md has a blast-radius table listing ITEM-001, ITEM-002 and AUTH-001

evals.prompt: Which tests does this change affect? Run the regression that matters. Diff: app.py dashboard() now reads visible_items(user) again instead of STALE_SNAPSHOT.
evals.workdir: assets/demo-app/ with ./qa and a previous qa-artifacts/ set (copy assets/examples/demo-app-engagement/qa-artifacts)

assertions.check: the transcript shows scripts/qa_status.py (or an equivalent read of qa-artifacts/) before any new artifact is written; finished artifacts are not regenerated
regression-report.md maps dashboard() → items table → F-002/F-003/F-004 → ITEM-001..003, AUTH-001, AUTH-004
a report.json exists whose selection contains --feature items or the listed --test ids, run before any full run
regression-report.md ends with a safe/not-safe conclusion citing the run id

evals.prompt: Add Selenium coverage for the delete-item dialog. We already have tests in tests/ui using pytest-selenium; keep our conventions.
evals.workdir: assets/demo-app/ plus a minimal tests/ui/conftest.py + test_login.py using pytest and selenium

assertions.check: no second runner is installed (no qa/run_tests.py); new tests live in tests/ui and use the project's fixtures
a pytest hook or fixture captures screenshot + page source on failure was added or already exists
qa-artifacts/ is produced (environment map, test cases with ids, execution report) even though the runner differs
environment-map.md states which runner is used and why

evals.prompt: Write and run Selenium E2E tests for this app.
evals.workdir: assets/demo-app/ on a machine with no browser installed (or QA_CHROME_BINARY pointing at a missing file)

assertions.check: the final message says the work is blocked at Gate 13 (or Gate 0) with the exact exception text and the evidence path
no execution-report.md claims PASS for a browser test; ENV-002 is ERROR or the run is absent
browser=False tests (API) were still executed and reported
